question: What is the inspiration behind Kokoro Letters?
answer: Kokoro Letters is a slow-craft passion project born from a deep love for Japan and its scenic wonders. Over the course of 12 months, we explore 12 handpicked regions across Japan that inspired iconic Studio Ghibli movies—bringing that quiet, nostalgic storytelling into physical snail mail.

question: What will I receive in my physical mailbox each month?
answer: Each monthly envelope is planned to include: 1) A scenic art print inspired by that month's region; 2) A custom-illustrated spirit sticker; 3) A collectible region stamp sticker for your map; and 4) A heartfelt creator letter exploring the region, local folklore, and the animated world it inspired.

question: How does the physical Japan Map work?
answer: Subscribers who join during our inaugural Month 1 batch receive an envelope-sized physical map of Japan with all 12 featured regions marked for free. Each month, as your new envelope arrives, you place that month's region stamp sticker onto its spot on the map. If you join in Month 2 or later, you can buy the map separately in the store.

question: Can I start with Month 1, buy the full year, or just join the waitlist?
answer: All three options are open! You can purchase just your First Month (which includes the free envelope-sized Japan map), prepay the Whole Year Bundle (2 months free), or join the free waitlist with zero payment if you prefer to wait for future updates.

question: When do letters ship and is tracking included?
answer: Dispatches are sent during the first week of each month. In India, Tracked Speed Post is included (typically 7–10 business days). Internationally, Standard Airmail is included in the $12 base price, and you can optionally add Tracked Airmail (ITPS) at checkout.

question: Will I be able to pause or cancel once subscriptions go live?
answer: Yes! Once paid batches open, you will be in complete control—able to pause, skip a month, or cancel anytime through your Travel Ledger or by emailing us.
